# pij-rs wire captures

Verbatim frames and envelopes captured from the live pij-rs daemon during plan 093
(archived at `docs/plans/archive/093-pij-rs-reader/assets/inputs/`, which keeps the
originals as the plan's evidence). Copied here so the reader's tests do not depend on
where a plan folder lives: archiving 093 once broke five test files at load time.
